description: This file defines the Marker class for the Leaflet mapping library, extending the Layer class to create clickable and draggable map markers with customizable options and behaviors.

classes.name: Marker
classes.description: A class for creating map markers that are clickable and draggable, with customizable icons and behaviors, extending the Layer class.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes a Marker instance with a given latitude/longitude and options.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles adding the marker to the map, setting up animations and icons.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles removing the marker from the map, cleaning up event hooks and icons.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns event handlers for map events like zoom and view reset.

methods.name: getLatLng
methods.description: Returns the current geographical position of the marker.

methods.name: setLatLng
methods.description: Sets a new geographical position for the marker and fires a move event.

methods.name: setZIndexOffset
methods.description: Adjusts the z-index offset of the marker.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the current icon used by the marker.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Changes the marker's icon and updates its display.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Returns the DOM element representing the marker icon.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the marker's position on the map.

methods.name: _initIcon
methods.description: Initializes the marker's icon element, adding classes and creating shadow if needed.

methods.name: _removeIcon
methods.description: Removes the icon element from the DOM.

methods.name: _removeShadow
methods.description: Removes the shadow element from the DOM.

methods.name: _setPos
methods.description: Sets the position of the icon and shadow elements.

methods.name: _updateZIndex
methods.description: Updates the z-index style of the icon element.

methods.name: _animateZoom
methods.description: Animates the marker during zoom events.

methods.name: _initInteraction
methods.description: Initializes interaction features like dragging and event handling.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.description: Changes the opacity of the marker.

methods.name: _updateOpacity
methods.description: Applies the opacity setting to icon and shadow elements.

methods.name: _bringToFront
methods.description: Raises the marker to the front visually.

methods.name: _resetZIndex
methods.description: Resets the z-index to default.

methods.name: _getPopupAnchor
methods.description: Returns the popup anchor point from icon options.

methods.name: _getTooltipAnchor
methods.description: Returns the tooltip anchor point from icon options.
